knowledge:
- key_parameters: subsets=used in addPerCellQC to specify control gene sets (e.g., mitochondrial genes) ;; exprs_values=used in plotHighestExprs and plotExpression to specify the assay to plot (e.g., "counts", "logcounts") ;; x=used in plotExpression to specify the covariate on the x-axis ;; colour_by=used in plotting functions to specify metadata or feature names for coloring ;; subset_row=used in runPCA to specify a subset of genes for PCA ;; ncomponents=used in runPCA and plotPCA to specify the number of components to compute or plot ;; name=used in runPCA to change the name of the PCA result in reducedDims ;; perplexity=used in runTSNE to set the perplexity parameter ;; dimred=used in runTSNE to specify a pre-existing dimensionality reduction result to use as input ;; n_dimred=used in runTSNE to specify the number of dimensions to use from the pre-existing reduction
- alternatives: scran, scuttle, and iSEE are alternative/interoperable Bioconductor packages; scuttle is used for addPerCellQC and logNormCounts; BiocSingular is the base machinery for runPCA; Rtsne is used for runTSNE; uwot is used for runUMAP; ggplot2 can be used directly with ggcells and ggfeatures for custom plotting
- when_to_use: When performing quality control, normalization, dimensionality reduction, and exploratory visualization of single-cell RNA-seq data stored in a SingleCellExperiment object
- pitfalls: If all spike-ins are in the top 50 most-expressed features, too much spike-in RNA was added ;; A large number of pseudo-genes or predicted genes in the top expressed features may indicate alignment problems ;; t-SNE results are highly sensitive to random seeds and perplexity values, so multiple seeds/perplexities should be tested ;; Running t-SNE directly on raw expression values is slow and noisy; using pre-existing PCA results (dimred="PCA") is highly recommended to improve speed and reduce noise

workflows.name: sc_rnaseq_qc_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Perform quality control, normalization, dimensionality reduction, and visualization of single-cell RNA-seq expression data.
input: example_sce (SingleCellExperiment object containing raw count data)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute quality control metrics using addPerCellQC ;; 2. Visualize QC metrics using plotColData and plotHighestExprs ;; 3. Normalize counts using logNormCounts ;; 4. Calculate and plot variance explained by experimental variables using getVarianceExplained and plotExplanatoryVariables ;; 5. Visualize gene expression profiles using plotExpression ;; 6. Perform dimensionality reduction using runPCA, runTSNE, and runUMAP ;; 7. Visualize reduced dimensions using plotReducedDim, plotTSNE, and plotPCA ;; 8. Create custom plots using ggcells and ggfeatures
workflows.code:
library(scRNAseq)
example_sce <- ZeiselBrainData()
example_sce

library(scater)
example_sce <- addPerCellQC(example_sce, 
    subsets=list(Mito=grep("mt-", rownames(example_sce))))

plotColData(example_sce, x = "sum", y="detected", colour_by="tissue") 

plotColData(example_sce, x = "sum", y="subsets_Mito_percent", 
    other_fields="tissue") + facet_wrap(~tissue)

plotHighestExprs(example_sce, exprs_values = "counts")

example_sce <- logNormCounts(example_sce)

vars <- getVarianceExplained(example_sce,
    variables=c("tissue", "total mRNA mol", "sex", "age"))
head(vars)

plotExplanatoryVariables(vars)

plotExpression(example_sce, rownames(example_sce)[1:6], x = "level1class")

plotExpression(example_sce, rownames(example_sce)[1:6],
    x = rownames(example_sce)[10])

plotExpression(example_sce, rownames(example_sce)[1:6],
    x = "level1class", colour_by="tissue")

plotExpression(example_sce, rownames(example_sce)[1:6])

example_sce <- runPCA(example_sce)
str(reducedDim(example_sce, "PCA"))

example_sce <- runPCA(example_sce, name="PCA2",
    subset_row=rownames(example_sce)[1:1000],
    ncomponents=25)
str(reducedDim(example_sce, "PCA2"))

set.seed(1000)
example_sce <- runTSNE(example_sce, perplexity=10)
head(reducedDim(example_sce, "TSNE"))

set.seed(1000)
example_sce <- runTSNE(example_sce, perplexity=50, 
    dimred="PCA", n_dimred=10)
head(reducedDim(example_sce, "TSNE"))

example_sce <- runUMAP(example_sce)
head(reducedDim(example_sce, "UMAP"))

plotReducedDim(example_sce, dimred = "PCA", colour_by = "level1class")

plotTSNE(example_sce, colour_by = "Snap25")

plotPCA(example_sce, colour_by="Mog")

example_sce <- runPCA(example_sce, ncomponents=20)
plotPCA(example_sce, ncomponents = 4, colour_by = "level1class")

ggcells(example_sce, mapping=aes(x=level1class, y=Snap25)) + 
    geom_boxplot() +
    facet_wrap(~tissue)

ggcells(example_sce, mapping=aes(x=TSNE.1, y=TSNE.2, colour=Snap25)) +
    geom_point() +
    stat_density_2d() +
    facet_wrap(~tissue) +
    scale_colour_distiller(direction=1)

ggcells(example_sce, mapping=aes(x=sizeFactor, y=Actb)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth()

colnames(example_sce) <- make.names(colnames(example_sce))
ggfeatures(example_sce, mapping=aes(x=featureType, y=X1772062111_E06)) + 
    geom_violin()
